jobs.occupation: Manager of Insurance Tax, Regulation & Compliance Germany (m/f/d) (Fachanwalt/-anwältin - Steuerrecht)
jobs.description: Shape compliance. Drive governance. Protect global business. At DHL Group, we connect people and improve lives through our global logistics network. Behind our world-leading operations stands a strong commitment to governance, compliance, and risk management. We are looking for an experienced Manager of Insurance Tax, Regulation & Compliance Germany (m/f/d) to play a pivotal role in ensuring that our insurance activities remain compliant, transparent, and future-ready. This position combines insurance taxation, regulatory compliance, governance, and stakeholder management in a highly international environment. Manager of Insurance Tax, Regulation & Compliance Germany (m/f/d)   Why experienced insurance professionals join this role* Move from advising to owning insurance governance decisions.* Shape multinational insurance programs across a global organization.* Influence strategic decisions involving Tax, Legal, Treasury, Procurement, and Risk Management.* Work at the intersection of insurance, regulation, governance, and business strategy.* Gain exposure to some of the most complex international insurance arrangements in the market. You'll make an impact by:* Defining and evolving DHL Group's global insurance governance framework.* Ensuring regulatory excellence across international insurance programs.* Leading complex tax, regulatory, and compliance initiatives.* Managing interactions with authorities, regulators, auditors, brokers, and insurers.* Providing strategic guidance on multinational insurance structures and cross-border risk solutions. What You Will Do:Insurance Tax & Compliance* Serve as the central expert for insurance premium tax matters in Germany.* Advise business stakeholders on insurance taxation, insurance distribution compliance, and regulatory requirements.* Assess domestic and international insurance programs, including multinational insurance structures, global master policies, local policies, captive insurance arrangements, and Freedom of Services (FOS) solutions.* Review and evaluate insurance premium tax treatment for insurance contracts and insurance-related services.* Support the design, implementation, and launch of new insurance programs while ensuring tax and regulatory compliance. Governance & Risk Management* Maintain and continuously improve insurance tax governance and compliance frameworks.* Design and oversee internal control systems for insurance premium tax processes.* Contribute to the enhancement of DHL Group's Tax Compliance Management System.* Conduct risk assessments and compliance reviews related to insurance distribution and taxation.* Promote transparency, documentation standards, and audit readiness across the organization.  Regulatory & Audit Management* Manage insurance premium tax audits and regulatory reviews independently.* Act as the primary contact for tax authorities, auditors, legal advisors, insurers, and brokers.* Develop strategies to address audit findings and mitigate regulatory risks.* Monitor developments in German and international insurance tax legislation and relevant court decisions.* Ensure regulatory awareness and compliance regarding insurance distribution activities in Germany. Cross-Functional Collaboration* Work closely with colleagues from Tax, Legal, Treasury, Procurement, Risk Management, and other business functions.* Support DHL business units in understanding and meeting insurance compliance requirements.* Coordinate with external advisors, brokers, insurers, and regulatory stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions. What You Bring* University degree in Law, Tax, Business Administration, Finance, Insurance, Risk Management, or a related field.* Several years of professional experience in insurance taxation, insurance regulation, compliance, risk management, legal, or related disciplines.* Proven expertise in German Insurance Premium Tax (IPT) regulations and insurance compliance requirements.* Experience managing regulatory inquiries, audits, disputes, and complex multinational insurance programs.* Strong understanding of commercial insurance products, including Property, Liability, Marine, Cargo, Cyber, D&O, Financial Lines, and Employee Benefits.* Experience developing governance, control, and compliance frameworks in international organizations.* Excellent English language skills and good German language proficiency. Who You AreYou are a strategic and analytical professional who enjoys navigating complex regulatory environments. You combine technical expertise with strong stakeholder management skills and are comfortable advising senior decision-makers. You thrive in international settings, communicate effectively, and maintain the highest standards of integrity and quality. What We Offer* A highly visible role with global impact across one of the world's leading logistics companies.* Exposure to complex international insurance, tax, and compliance topics.* Opportunities to collaborate with senior stakeholders across multiple functions and regions.* A diverse, inclusive, and collaborative working environment.* Continuous professional development and career growth opportunities within DHL Group.(Employer value proposition formulated based on the role's global scope and responsibilities.) Why DHL Group?At DHL Group, we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can contribute and grow. We value diverse perspectives and believe that our people are the key to our success. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, skills, experience, and performance. Your benefits * Well-Being: Fun, team spirit, and health are crucial factors. Therefore, within the company, we offer a wide range of health and preventive care services, an occupational physician* Family-friendly: The compatibility of family and work has many facets, such as childcare, care for family members, etc. We support this, for example, through kindergarten places as well as the Betreuungs- und Erholungswerk (support and recreation program).* Employee Share Program: As an employee, you have the opportunity to participate in DHL Group's employee share program and share directly in the company's long-term success.* Mobility: We move not only letters or parcels but also our employees through offerings such as company bicycles, job tickets and possibly company cars.* Location: The Post Campus brings together people from more than 60 countries. The Post Tower is easily accessible by car, public transportation and bicycle. To facilitate the workday, the campus offers amenities such as parking spaces, post office, café, canteen and more.* Onboarding: Individual onboarding, training on the job, networking, a dedicated certified program, etc., lay the foundation for a successful start at DHL Group.* Development opportunities: We offer numerous development opportunities through a comprehensive training landscape, junior talent programs, coaching etc.* Social commitment: Through global corporate programs, we improve the educational and career opportunities for young people and engage in disaster management at airports. We also contribute to local environmental protection and aid projects initiated by employees on a voluntary basis.* What else? Company pension plan, social counseling, inclusion consulting, cleaning service, insurance cooperation, corporate discounts, events, sabbaticals and much more! About DHL GroupDHL Group is the world’s leading logistics company, connecting people and businesses in more than 220 countries and territories through a comprehensive portfolio of logistics, e-commerce, parcel, express, freight forwarding, and supply chain management services.With approximately 580,000 employees worldwide, DHL Group operates one of the largest global logistics networks.Our purpose is simple: Connecting People. Improving Lives. Apply now with your complete documents, stating your salary expectations, using the application button. For further information, please visit careers.dhl.com. For initial personal contact and any questions, please contact Sven Rötzel at sven.roetzel@dhl.com or 0228-189-52128. We look forward to receiving your application*.CONNECTING PEOPLE. Your area of responsibility Research topic: Plant immunity Plant pathogens secrete small molecules in their host to manipulate cellular processes and cause disease. Plants are not defenseless, however, and have evolved a wide variety of immune receptors to sense these pathogen-associated molecules and subsequently trigger an immune response to restrict pathogen infection. In the Molecular Plant Immunity research group, we investigate the molecular basis of effector recognition and immune receptor activation, and how evolutionary forces shape these processes. We then leverage this knowledge to develop strategies for sustainable disease resistance in crops. Your tasks:• Independent execution of molecular biology laboratory tasks• Microbiological work with bacteria and fungi under sterile conditions• Organization and maintenance of standardized workflows in the laboratory• Plant husbandry• Support lab members in their experiments• Documenting experimental procedures and resultsYour profile• Completed training as a Biological technical assistant or equivalent• Independent and solution-oriented work ethic• Enthusiasm for teamwork• Ability to work in a multi-cultural, multi-ethnic environment with sensitivity and respect for diversity• Desirable knowledge and skills include:• Good English language skills (written and spoken)• Experience in microbiology and molecular biology work• Experience in handling biosafety S1 organismsPlease apply with a cover letter and your CV containing the contact details of two referees and by the 7th of December 2026. If you have any questions, please contact Clemence Marchal (clemence.marchal@ipb-halle.de).We offer• Modern Working Conditions: Comprehensive introduction to work techniques and a modern research environment with state-of-the-art equipment and up-to-date software• Career Development: Targeted training opportunities and access to a specialized library with electronic resources and quiet workspaces• Compensation & Security: Classification according to TV-L including annual bonus, pension scheme (VBL), health offers, and discounted canteen meals• Ideal Working Environment: A varied and inspiring workplace in an international setting at a leading scientific and innovation hub• Team Spirit and Leadership Culture: An open culture that strengthens teamwork, enables career networking, and promotes your research skills.• Work-Life Balance: Flexible working models, remote work options, and 30 days of annual leave – for a balanced work-life experience.About us The Leibniz Institute of Plant Biochemistry (IPB) is a non-university research institution of the Leibniz Association on the Weinberg Campus of the Martin Luther University Halle-Wittenberg. As a foundation under public law, the IPB is under direct supervision of the state of Saxony-Anhalt.The IPB is an internationally recognized research institution and consists of four scientific Departments, additional independent junior research groups, and the Department Administration & Infrastructure (about 200 employees, including about 40 PhD students). Research at the IPB aims to understand the (bio)chemical basis of plant resilience and performance in challenging environments related to climate change. The IPB offers excellent research facilities and state-of-the-art infrastructure to investigate the chemical diversity, biochemical interactions, and biological roles of small natural molecules in plants and fungi, with an emphasis on specialized metabolites, chemical mediators, and relevant molecular networks of functional gene and protein regulation (https://www.ipb-halle.de/en/).Dr. Clemence MarchalResearch AssociateTelefon: 0345 55821440clemence.marchal@ipb-halle.deLeibniz-Institut für Pflanzenbiochemie (IPB)Weinberg 306120 Halle (Saale)

jobs.occupation: Research associate (m/f/x) for the CRC 1844 "Episodic Memory", Subproject A16 (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description: In order to fill a fixed-term position in part-time (29.87 hours/week = 75%) 01.01.2027, pending funding approval, we are looking for oneResearch associate (m/f/x) for the CRC 1844 "Episodic Memory", Subproject A16The Department of Predictive Cognition is a newly established research unit within the Faculty of Psychology. After the completion of the new THINK research building on the former Opel site Mark 51°7, the team will move there https://www.ruhr-uni-bochum.de/think/index.html.en. The research focus of our department is on combining neuroimaging and behavioural measurements with computational models to understand how the human brain learns and uses prior expectations during cognition. More information can be found here: https://blanklab.eu/The position is part of the Collaborative Research Center “Episodic Memory” (CRC 1844), an interdisciplinary consortium consisting of researchers from psychology, computational neuroscience, philosophy, and neuroscience. The basis for our research is the Scenario Construction Framework, which conceptualizes episodic memory as mental simulations of past episodes, constructed from episodic memory traces and semantic information. As a part of this team, you will be trained in interdisciplinary research and have access to a broad spectrum of initiatives to support you in your academic journey. When we communicate with others, our perception of their speech is continuously guided by the memory of our past interactions. But how? In this CRC subproject A16 " Integration of episodic traces and semantic other-person models in a social context", we will investigate how memory traces of previously heard dialogues and the other-person model, which contains general semantic knowledge about the person, modify speech perception. This project places the generative model of scenario construction within a social context. Using functional magnetic resonance imaging, we investigate how EM traces and other-person models differentially influence the neural representation of speech and language. We are looking for an enthusiastic researcher with a Master's degree in psychology, cognitive science, or a related field and strong programming and statistical skills to carry out the proposed project.Scope: part-timeDuration: fixed-term, 31.12.2030 (end of project)Start: 01.01.2027, pending funding approvalApply by:  2026-11-30Your tasks:- Organization and execution of experimental research work, from programming experimental setups, data acquisition, and data analysis, to the dissemination of the results- Acquisition of MRI data- Analysis and publication of MRI data- Practice of Open Science Practices- Close collaboration with PIs and ECRs from other subprojectsYour profile:- A Master of Science or an equivalent degree in neuroscience, cognitive science, psychology, or a related discipline- Strong programming and statistical skills- Experience in experimental approaches to study predictive processing, memory, learning, and communication- Prior experience with fMRI is an advantage- Experience and keen interest in using large language models- Strong organizational skills- A high level of spoken and written English- Highly self-motivated and eager to learn- Working independently, in a structured manner, and with a focus on results- Enjoy working as part of an interdisciplinary team of researchershttps://jobs.ruhr-uni-bochum.de/jobposting/c0bf34da8b741897fe8de879edc88d7edfbdf8730?ref=AfA (https://jobs.ruhr-uni-bochum.de/jobposting/c0bf34da8b741897fe8de879edc88d7edfbdf8730?ref=AfA)

CASA aims to strengthen the resilience of our digital society. Thematic priorities include the security of quantum technologies, protection against Al-based disinformation and societal polarization, and new approaches to defending against ransomware. In addition to technical questions, it also investigates the interaction of human behavior and cybersecurity. It comprises 18 subprojects led by 22 principal investigators across six universities and is coordinated at Ruhr University Bochum (RUB). CRC 1844 investigates episodic memory—the ability to remember specific events from one’s personal past—from multiple disciplinary perspectives. A central goal of the consortium is to communicate research on episodic memory and its relevance beyond the scientific community, foster dialogue between science and society, and to develop innovative educational and participatory formats for engaging different target groups with research on episodic memory.We are seeking an Outreach Coordinator to lead the strategic development, implementation, and coordination of outreach and science communication activities within CRC 1844.
